data.one_liner: Dio-based HTTP inspector that logs requests and responses in a Flutter app
data.what_it_does: It intercepts Dio HTTP calls, stores logs, and provides a UI to view, filter, and replicate requests. It also offers a draggable debug button for quick access.
use_when: You need to debug Dio HTTP traffic in a Flutter app
You want an in-app UI to inspect requests and responses
You want to replicate requests for testing
avoid_when: You are using a different HTTP client like http or GraphQL
You need a full-featured network monitoring tool outside the app
You want a lightweight solution without UI
strengths: Provides UI for filtering and replication
Configurable max log count and error detection
weaknesses: Only works with Dio (though interceptor can be adapted)
UI is basic and may not fit all design guidelines
Requires manual addition of debug button or navigation
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, add DioLogInterceptor to dio.interceptors, optionally add showDebugBtn or navigate to HttpLogListWidget
